## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [禪修](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%A6%AA%E4%BF%AE) Chánxiū is a late-Míng Buddhist repentance ritual (*shìchàn* 事懺 — "phenomenal repentance," distinct from *lǐchàn* 理懺 "principial repentance") based on the *Śūraṅgama-sūtra* tradition. Like its predecessor *[Shǒulèngyán tánchǎng xiūzhèng yí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0157)* (X1477) by [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán, the work treats the *Lèngyán* as part of the broader Huáyán-school ritual heritage.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1500 – 1644) reflects the broad late-Míng period during which Chánxiū was active. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1478) collection.
